# Sharkings Interiors & Exteriors

> Leading Interior Design Firm & Modular Kitchen Specialist in Madurai & Ramanathapuram (Ramnad), Tamil Nadu since 2010.

## Overview
Sharkings Interiors & Exteriors is a premier, full-service residential and commercial interior design studio, modular kitchen manufacturer, and turnkey execution contractor serving Madurai, Ramanathapuram (Ramnad), Rameswaram, Paramakudi, Sivagangai, Theni, and surrounding regions in Southern Tamil Nadu.

## Key Facts
- **Founded**: 2010 (Over 15+ years of design and manufacturing excellence)
- **Specializations**: Turnkey Residential Interiors, Custom Modular Kitchens, Commercial Spaces, Exterior ACP Elevation, Modular Wardrobes, Container Architecture.
- **Experience Centres**:
  - **Madurai Atelier**: Plot No. 3552, TNHB Colony, Villapuram, Madurai, Tamil Nadu 625001.
  - **Ramanathapuram Centre**: Bus Stop, 13/2993/26, Madurai - Rameswaram Hwy, Subbaiah Nagar, Ram Nagar, Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu 623501.
- **Primary Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 80980 90204
- **Email**: sharkingsindia@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://www.sharkingsinteriors.in

## Primary Services
- **Modular Kitchen Design**: Acrylic, Laminate, PVC, and Marine Plywood waterproof modular kitchens (L-shape, U-shape, Parallel, Island, Straight).
- **Home Interiors**: Complete living room hall designs, TV cabinets, false ceilings with LED profile lighting, master bedroom interiors.
- **Modular Wardrobes**: Sliding wardrobes, lacquered glass wardrobes, walk-in closets, hinged doors.
- **Commercial & Office Design**: Retail stores, beauty salons, spas, corporate offices, glass partitions, reception areas.
- **Exterior ACP Elevation**: Front elevation designs, ACP sheet cladding, HPL panels, exterior louvers, glass facades.
- **Container Architecture**: Custom shipping container homes, container cafes, modular office spaces.

## Service Coverage Areas
- **Madurai District**: Villapuram, Anna Nagar, KK Nagar, SS Colony, Bypass Road, Kalavasal, Tallakulam, Pudur, Sellur, Goripalayam, Melur, Tirumangalam, Usilampatti, Mattuthavani, Kochadai, Alagappan Nagar.
- **Ramanathapuram District**: Ramanathapuram town, Ramnad, Rameswaram, Paramakudi, Kilakarai, Devipattinam, Mudukulathur, Kamuthi, Sayalgudi, Mandapam.
- **Neighboring Districts**: Sivagangai, Karaikudi, Theni, Dindigul, Virudhunagar, Aruppukottai, Rajapalayam, Sivakasi.
